newsitem.title: USA: Emerson backs Sport Supply contract with CEO.
newsitem.headline: Emerson backs Sport Supply contract with CEO.

text.p: Emerson Radio Corp said Wednesday it backed a contractual commitment to Michael Blumenfeld, Sport Supply's chief executive and chairman as part of its revised offer to buy more shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Emerson said it was its intention not to require Blumenfeld to resign or enter into a consulting or non-competition agreement before the deal closes.
Emerson is proposing to acquire 1.7 million shares of Sport Supply at $7 per share. Originally, it proposed to buy 1.33 million shares at $6 per share.

Emerson took this position because the language of its original proposal appeared to require Blumenfeld, a founder of Sport Supply, to resign prior to the deal's closing, the company said in the filing.
Emerson said under its revised proposal, it may be paid a termination fee of $750,000 instead of $1 million if the deal falls through for any reason except for willful failure to close by Emerson.
Sport Supply is a direct marketer of sporting equipment.
